name: pi-cli-bedrock
description: One-shot installer that runs pi coding agent with Amazon Bedrock (Kimi K3.1) on AWS CloudShell, macOS, Linux and Windows, with AWS MCP Server and an AWS ops guard

scripts.lint: shellcheck -x install.sh uninstall.sh lib/*.sh bin/pi bin/pi-bedrock-doctor bin/pi-bedrock-login bin/aws-mcp-proxy $(ls tests/e2e/*.sh tests/windows/*.sh tests/bench/*.sh 2>/dev/null)
scripts.test: bats tests && npm run -s test:guard && npm run -s test:unit
